task_description.overview: Visualize seismic waveform data stored in a DASPy Section object.
steps: Import the DASPy read function and load the seismic section data into a Section object.
Call the Section.plot() method without arguments to display the waveform image.
Optionally show the figure if not automatically rendered.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Load the seismic data using daspy.read(das_data_path), obtaining a Section object. Visulaize the waveform image by calling sec.plot() function or using matplotlib to show the image. 
 Note: 1) Save the das waveform plot to {result_plot}.
